Asset type: transparent rear-facing plush BODY LAYER for an existing 224x256 game sprite.
Input image 1: original front sprite, authoritative identity, silhouette, position, scale, palette and upper-right light. Input image 2: first rear-view draft, a reference for rear fur anatomy only.
Primary request: create the same animal turned completely away from the camera. Correct the draft into a BODY-ONLY layer. Remove the entire pot AND BOTH GREEN LEAVES from the generated output. The ORIGINAL reference pot and original leaves will be pasted on top later, so generate uninterrupted furry back wherever leaves/pot previously occluded it. This production separation is required to lock those original foreground pixels exactly.
Ear placement must match image 1 rather than mirror it: the ear on the LEFT of the picture is higher (near x=66,y=40 in a 224x256 canvas), and the ear on the RIGHT is lower (near x=165,y=80). Keep the gently clockwise-tilted original head silhouette. Exactly two round blue outer ear backs. Tiny round blue tail at the lower center of the back, partly hidden by the original leaves when composited.
Show only the back of the skull, the outer backs of ears, and the short compact lower furry back. No eyes, nose, mouth, muzzle, cheek blush, visible inner ears, or front facial features. No paws, feet, standing body or long exposed torso.
Canvas/framing: true transparent background, 7:8 canvas corresponding to 224x256. Keep the same upper-body silhouette HEIGHT and WIDTH and CENTER as image 1. Topmost fur approximately y=15, never above y=6. Continue the compact furry lower back down to y=156 behind the future two leaves and pot rim, but do not extend below y=160. Rows below that must be empty transparent. Leave the original lateral margins and generous bottom transparency. Do not zoom or recenter to fill the entire canvas. It will be composited with leaves fixed near y=125-150 and the original pot from y=148 downward.
Surface: same realistic soft plush fibers and exact character color as image 1, with soft upper-right studio illumination and clean furry silhouette edges. No stronger glossy shine or overexposure. No cast shadow, no floor, no background, no checkerboard, no text, no watermark, no second view.
CRITICAL output: animal back ONLY. NO pot, NO green leaves, NO plant parts. The pot and leaves are added from the unchanged source later.
